title: Cue hackathon video
status: Playable 60-second HTML prototype with all nine supplied ElevenLabs takes embedded and aligned. Real screen captures and MP4 export are pending.
creativeDirection: Friendly minimalism: warm off-white, lavender, large Manrope typography, restrained transitions, and the original Cue mascot in reading, writing and waving poses. Marcel’s week-old context is revealed after the reply. Marta’s everyday weekend exchange demonstrates the saved coffee goal, Flirty tone and Subtle intensity.
voiceDirection: Warm, conversational English with restrained delivery. Cue is pronounced like cue/queue. Leave a pause during the opening and silence during the first reply reveal. Use voiceover.txt as spoken text; generate a clean WAV or high-quality MP3 in ElevenLabs. Align the edit to the finished audio.
audioDirection: Voice first. A quiet licensed instrumental bed and subtle interaction sounds are optional.
evidence: The exam and flirting scenarios are staged product examples. Record real Cue actions and actual AI outputs. Marta is the on-screen alias in the second conversation; omit the real Messenger header there. Existing English stills are translated presentation assets, and the existing source recording concerns a different debt scenario. These are reference material, not fresh footage for this revised storyboard.

shots.headline: finally done 😮‍💨
shots.voice: You care. But sometimes, you don’t know what to say.
shots.visual: Marcel’s latest staged message in the real Messenger conversation. Empty reply field and a blinking cursor.
shots.purpose: A familiar moment before the product reveal.

shots.headline: Cue
shots.voice: Meet Cue. An AI keyboard that uses your conversation’s context to help you reply in your own voice.
shots.visual: Clean Cue logo and a readable view of the real keyboard.

shots.headline: Right where you chat.
shots.voice: Tap Suggest. No copying chats into another assistant. No explaining the background from scratch.
shots.visual: Real screen recording in Marcel’s Messenger compose field: Cue has Marcel selected; tap Suggest with Natural tone and no saved goal.
shots.purpose: Show the default context-aware flow without asking the user to explain an obvious intention.
captureRequirements: Clear any previously saved conversation goal before recording.
Keep the tap on Suggest visible.

shots.headline: Words that fit.
shots.illustrativeReply: how did the exams go? less stressful than you expected?
shots.visual: Enlarge and hold the actual generated reply, ideally one that visibly uses Marcel’s exam context. Keep the earlier source message unrevealed until the next scene.
shots.purpose: A quiet, readable product payoff. The illustrative reply is not a promised model output.

shots.headline: A week earlier.
shots.quote: got exams next week. already stressing 😬
shots.voice: A week ago, Marcel mentioned his exams. Cue connects that earlier message to what he’s saying now.
shots.visual: After the reply payoff, reveal Marcel’s earlier staged message about exams next week. An animated “A week earlier” quote card connects it to “finally done”. The story chronology is staged; keep source timestamps consistent with the prepared scenario.
shots.purpose: Reveal the remembered context after the result, making the week-old connection the payoff.

shots.headline: See the context.
shots.voice: Open the source to see the message behind what Cue remembers.
shots.visual: Show Marcel’s remembered exam detail, then open its source and the earlier message about exams next week.
shots.purpose: Show verifiable conversation memory in the same exam story.

shots.headline: Your direction.
shots.voice: Have something in mind? Set a goal. Choose your tone. And keep it subtle—or make it bolder.
shots.illustrativeReply: then coffee with me on saturday? 😊
shots.visual: Clearly transition to the separate conversation labelled Marta in Cue. Show the normal weekend exchange, with the real Messenger header cropped out. Enter the optional coffee goal, open the tone control, swipe Natural to Flirty, select Subtle, and tap Suggest. Hold the actual generated invitation.
shots.purpose: Show how context, a saved conversation goal, tone and intensity combine to suggest a fitting next reply. The goal remains saved for later replies; this film shows one moment rather than a multi-message goal montage.
captureRequirements: Use a separate staged ordinary conversation about weekend plans, with the latest message giving Saturday availability.
Marta is the on-screen alias in Cue; crop out the real Messenger contact header.
Show entering the goal once, swiping the tone carousel from Natural to Flirty, selecting Subtle on the intensity control, then pressing Suggest.
Use actual generated output. The illustrative invitation is a placeholder, not a promised AI response.

shots.headline: Choose. Review. Send.
shots.voice: Choose a suggestion. Review it. You decide what to send.
shots.visual: Insert the selected suggestion unchanged, review it, and hold on the send control. Editing remains optional.
shots.purpose: Show a ready-to-use suggestion and the user’s final decision.

shots.headline: Undefined
shots.voice: Built from scratch at HackYeah by two eighteen-year-olds.

shots.purpose: Team and implementation details after the product story.

shots.headline: Cue
shots.voice: Cue. The context behind your words.
shots.visual: Cue logo and final line. A calm final hold.
